questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trees are walls.

No wall is a door.

Some doors are rooms.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rooms are walls.

II. No trees are doors.

III. All walls are trees.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c94440c29b147f037d3e19f3069036a2da44e0937fa788ab7899fe9f37ef498e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rooms are walls. → Does not follow (As, there is no definite relation between rooms and walls. Hence, false)

II. No trees are doors. → **Follows** (As, All trees are walls and No wall is a door, which implies no trees are doors)

III. All walls are trees. → Does not follow (As, All trees are walls, which implies some walls are trees)

Hence, ‘**Only conclusion II follows**’ is the correct answer.

• The **42ⁿd Amendment Act, of 1976, was passed during the period of Emergency in India,** and it brought about many significant changes to the Constitution.
 
• 
 
The ‘Preamble’ of the Constitution of India is a brief introductory statement that sets out the guiding purpose and principles of the document, and it indicates the source from which the document which derives its authority, meaning, the people.

 
 
• It was adopted on 26 November 1949 by the Constituent Assembly of India and came into effect on 26th January 1950.
 
• After the 42nd amendment, three new terms "Socialist, Secular, and Integrity" were added to the Preamble.
 
 
• 42ⁿd Amendment Act, 1976 is one of the most important amendments to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It was enacted by the Indian National Congress headed by Indira Gandhi.
 
• Due to the large number of amendments this act has brought to the Indian Constitution, it is also known as the ‘Mini-Constitution.’ 
 
 
 
• Only one time the Preamble was amended in 1976 till date.
 
• 
 
Thus, it is clear that through the 42nd Amendment the word 'secular' is added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: Two trains start at the same time from Bangalore and Chennai and proceed towards each other at the speeds of 80 km/h and 95 km/h. When they meet, it is found that one train has travelled 180 km more than the other. The distance between Bangalore and Chennai is:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When time is constant, Distance ∝ Speed.

Difference in Speed = 95 − 80 = 15 km/h.

Total Speed = 95 + 80 = 175 km/h.

Total Distance = (Total Speed ÷ Difference in Speed) × Difference in Distance

Total Distance = (175 ÷ 15) × 180 = 175 × 12 = 2100 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 2100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of first train = 80 km/h

Speed of second train = 95 km/h

Difference in distance travelled at meeting time = 180 km

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3936af0792450c651f57e7a2494dda9a5685edd766a57df7ceb79b4c9b013cd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the time taken for both trains to meet be t hours.

⇒ Distance covered by first train = 80 × t

⇒ Distance covered by second train = 95 × t

⇒ The difference in distance covered = 95t − 80t = 15t

⇒ 15t = 180

⇒ t = 180 ÷ 15 = 12 hours

⇒ Total distance between Bangalore and Chennai = 80t + 95t = 175t

⇒ Total distance = 175 × 12

⇒ Total distance = 2100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 2100 km.**

Relative Speed (Opposite Directions)

When two bodies move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (|S₁ − S₂|).

Constant Time Property
